topics.title: Need for a theory base and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why accounting needs a theory base to make information reliable and comparable.
Describe the meaning, evolution and changing nature of GAAP.

topics.title: Business entity, money measurement and going concern

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the business entity concept to capital, drawings and personal transactions of the owner.
Identify what can be recorded under money measurement and state its limitation.
Explain how the going concern assumption allows the cost of an asset to be spread over its life.

topics.title: Accounting period, cost and dual aspect

concepts.learning_objective: State the meaning of accounting period and the periods for which statements are prepared.
Calculate the cost at which an asset is recorded and evaluate the historical cost basis.
Analyse the two-fold effect of transactions using the accounting equation.

topics.title: Revenue recognition, matching and full disclosure

concepts.learning_objective: Determine when revenue is realised, including time-based incomes.
Apply the matching concept to expenses and the cost of goods sold.
State what the full disclosure concept requires of financial statements.
Explain why consistent accounting policies are needed for comparison.
Apply the prudence rule of providing for all losses but not anticipating profits.
Distinguish material from immaterial items and explain the need for verifiable evidence.
Distinguish the double entry system from the single entry system.
Compare the cash basis and the accrual basis of accounting and compute profit under each.
State the meaning, issuing body and objectives of accounting standards.
Evaluate the benefits and limitations of accounting standards.

topics.title: Goods and Services Tax
topics.ncert_sections: Goods and Services Tax (One Country One Tax)

concepts.learning_objective: Explain GST as a destination-based tax and state its features and advantages.
Apply CGST, SGST and IGST to intra-state and inter-state supplies.
